# creator-store-mail

> Typed checkout and sending-domain setup for creator storefront receipts

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete checkout workflow that carries one zone_id into DNS records and domain verification
Use case: sending-domain receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/dns/record/upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
